summary: Launch Two Acquisition Corp., a Cayman Islands SPAC, filed an 8-K disclosing that on September 30, 2026 it issued 5,749,999 Class A ordinary shares to Launch Two Sponsor LLC upon conversion of an equal number of Class B shares. Post-conversion, 28,749,999 Class A shares and one Class B share are outstanding; the shares carry transfer restrictions, redemption waivers and a business-combination voting covenant. Separately, a September 14, 2026 definitive proxy seeks an EGM vote to extend the combination deadline from October 9, 2026 to April 9, 2027, alongside Non-Redemption Agreements with the sponsor. Watch extension approval and redemptions.
